ADMIN_ROLE_REQUIRED.title: Admin role required
ADMIN_ROLE_REQUIRED.description: You need an admin role to do that.

INVALID_CREDENTIALS.title: Invalid credentials
INVALID_CREDENTIALS.description: Check your username and password and try again.

CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT.title: Current password incorrect
CURRENT_PASSWORD_INCORRECT.description: The current password you entered is incorrect.

ACCOUNT_HAS_NO_PASSWORD.title: Account has no password
ACCOUNT_HAS_NO_PASSWORD.description: This account does not use a password.

SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED.title: Setup already completed
SETUP_ALREADY_COMPLETED.description: Initial setup has already been completed.

PLEX_USER_NOT_LINKED.title: Plex user not linked
PLEX_USER_NOT_LINKED.description: No account linked to this Plex user. Ask the admin to register you.

CAN_ONLY_MODIFY_OWN_REQUESTS.title: Can only modify own requests
CAN_ONLY_MODIFY_OWN_REQUESTS.description: You can only modify your own requests.

EMAIL_MANAGED_BY_PLEX.title: Email managed by Plex
EMAIL_MANAGED_BY_PLEX.description: Your email is managed by Plex.

PLEX_ALREADY_LINKED.title: Plex account already linked
PLEX_ALREADY_LINKED.description: This Plex account is already linked to another user.

PASSWORD_REQUIRED_BEFORE_UNLINK.title: Password required before unlinking Plex
PASSWORD_REQUIRED_BEFORE_UNLINK.description: Set a password before unlinking Plex, otherwise you would be locked out.

OWNER_MUST_REMAIN_ADMIN.title: Owner must remain an admin
OWNER_MUST_REMAIN_ADMIN.description: The owner must remain an admin.

AT_LEAST_ONE_ADMIN_REQUIRED.title: At least one admin required
AT_LEAST_ONE_ADMIN_REQUIRED.description: There must be at least one admin.

CANNOT_DELETE_OWN_ACCOUNT.title: Cannot delete own account
CANNOT_DELETE_OWN_ACCOUNT.description: You cannot delete your own account.

OWNER_CANNOT_BE_DELETED.title: Owner cannot be deleted
OWNER_CANNOT_BE_DELETED.description: The owner account cannot be deleted.

USER_NOT_FOUND.title: User not found
USER_NOT_FOUND.description: That user could not be found.

EMAIL_TAKEN.title: Email already in use
EMAIL_TAKEN.description: A user with this email already exists.

PLEX_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: Plex not configured
PLEX_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: Plex is not configured. Add a server URL and token in Settings.

PLEX_UNREACHABLE.title: Plex unreachable
PLEX_UNREACHABLE.description: Could not reach the Plex server to identify it.

ALBUM_NOT_FOUND.title: Album not found
ALBUM_NOT_FOUND.description: That album could not be found.

PLAYLIST_NOT_FOUND.title: Playlist not found
PLAYLIST_NOT_FOUND.description: That playlist could not be found.

TRACK_NOT_FOUND.title: Track not found
TRACK_NOT_FOUND.description: That track could not be found.

COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND.title: Collection not found
COLLECTION_NOT_FOUND.description: That collection could not be found.

REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.title: Request not found
REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.description: That request could not be found.

API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.title: API key not found
API_KEY_NOT_FOUND.description: That API key could not be found.

OAUTH_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.title: Authorization request not found
OAUTH_REQUEST_NOT_FOUND.description: Authorization request not found or expired.

DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: Download failed
DOWNLOAD_FAILED.description: The download could not be completed. Check the logs and try again.

BATCH_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.title: Batch download failed
BATCH_DOWNLOAD_FAILED.description: The batch download could not be completed. Check the logs and try again.

LIBRARY_SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: Library source not configured
LIBRARY_SOURCE_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: This integration is not configured by the admin yet.

LIBRARY_SOURCE_CALLBACK_FAILED.title: Library source callback failed
LIBRARY_SOURCE_CALLBACK_FAILED.description: The library source callback failed. Try again.

LIDARR_CONNECTION_FAILED.title: Lidarr connection failed
LIDARR_CONNECTION_FAILED.description: Failed to connect to Lidarr. Check the URL and API key in Settings.

LIDARR_SEARCH_FAILED.title: Lidarr search failed
LIDARR_SEARCH_FAILED.description: Failed to search artists in Lidarr.

LIDARR_ADD_ARTIST_FAILED.title: Lidarr add artist failed
LIDARR_ADD_ARTIST_FAILED.description: Failed to add the artist to Lidarr.

LIDARR_CHECK_ARTIST_FAILED.title: Lidarr check artist failed
LIDARR_CHECK_ARTIST_FAILED.description: Failed to check the artist in Lidarr.

LIDARR_ARTIST_EXISTS.title: Artist already exists in Lidarr
LIDARR_ARTIST_EXISTS.description: This artist already exists in Lidarr.

VALUE_ALREADY_IN_USE.title: Value already in use
VALUE_ALREADY_IN_USE.description: That value is already in use.

GENERIC_FALLBACK.title: Something went wrong
GENERIC_FALLBACK.description: Please try again. If it keeps failing, check the logs.

NETWORK_ERROR.title: Network error
NETWORK_ERROR.description: Could not reach the server. Check your connection and try again.

FORBIDDEN.title: Not allowed
FORBIDDEN.description: You do not have permission for that action.

SPOTIFY_PREMIUM_PROPAGATION.title: Spotify is rejecting API calls for the app owner
SPOTIFY_PREMIUM_PROPAGATION.description: Spotify requires the app owner's account to have an active Premium subscription. If Premium was just enabled, changes can take a few hours to propagate. Synthseek will keep your tokens and retry automatically.

SPOTIFY_NOT_CONFIGURED.title: Spotify is not configured
SPOTIFY_NOT_CONFIGURED.description: Ask your administrator to set the Client ID and Public Base URL in Settings.

SPOTIFY_USER_NOT_REGISTERED.title: Your Spotify account is not allowed yet
SPOTIFY_USER_NOT_REGISTERED.description: This Spotify app is in development mode, so it only works for accounts on its user list. Ask your administrator to add your Spotify account (your login email) to the app in the Spotify Developer Dashboard, then connect again.

SPOTIFY_STATE_EXPIRED.title: Authorization link expired
SPOTIFY_STATE_EXPIRED.description: The OAuth state expired before you finished the handshake. Click Connect Spotify again.

SPOTIFY_SESSION_EXPIRED.title: Synthseek session expired
SPOTIFY_SESSION_EXPIRED.description: Log in again, then retry connecting Spotify.

SPOTIFY_EXCHANGE_FAILED.title: Spotify connection failed
SPOTIFY_EXCHANGE_FAILED.description: Synthseek could not complete the OAuth exchange. Check the server logs and retry.

SPOTIFY_PROXY_ERROR.title: Could not reach Synthseek backend
SPOTIFY_PROXY_ERROR.description: The callback could not talk to the API. Check that the backend is running and try again.

SPOTIFY_MISSING_PARAMS.title: Spotify did not return an authorization code
SPOTIFY_MISSING_PARAMS.description: Try again. If it keeps happening, check the Redirect URI in your Spotify App settings.

SPOTIFY_ACCESS_DENIED.title: You declined the Spotify authorization
SPOTIFY_ACCESS_DENIED.description: Click Connect Spotify again whenever you are ready.

SPOTIFY_CONNECTED.title: Spotify connected
SPOTIFY_CONNECTED.description: Open Import from providers to start importing your library.
